notes.title: Version 1.0.11 released for playtest
notes.content:
I have fixed some small issues around in the game:
[list]
[*] Fixed: It was not always possible to complete the vacuum quest
[*] Added: New ship selection dialog, when you have completed one of the difficulties
[*] Updated : The Credits screen has been updated
[*]Fixed: The statistics screen could show your rank wrong
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest version 1.0.7 released
notes.content:
Just released version 1.0.7 of the playtest and with this a few bugs and changes have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Added: The new ship selection screen. Will be available once a difficulty has been completed
[*] Fixed: Plasma rockets would target different pickups
[*] Fixed: Font scaling on some screen resolutions were too big
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed a bug that prevented the statistics page from being shown
notes.content: I just uploaded version "1.0.6 playtest" which fixes a bug that prevented the statistics page from being shown after a playthrough. This statistics page shows a lot of good information about your play. And it will also show how you're listed on the leaderboards.
